desc: Ideation: two-layer structure (window median costs + non-overlap DP) and key pitfalls.
Implement full solution using coordinate-compressed Fenwick trees for window costs and O(nk) DP.
Execute sample tests: Example 1 gives 8, Example 2 gives 3 (both PASS).
Verify edge cases: k=1, x=n, adjacent non-overlapping windows, all-duplicate values, all-negative values, even-length median convention.
Confirm performance for n=1e5, k=15 (O(n log n) build + O(nk) DP) and Python integer safety; verify cost[i-x] indexing.
Median-of-deviations cost formula (2*(med*cl - sl) + total - med*x) verified analytically and against sampled windows.
